grade_rationale: 5 P1s (C allows max 2) + 26% overall spec coverage (C requires min 40%)

escalations.title: vitest@2.0.5 arbitrary file read & code execution
@stdlib/number-float64-base-exponent-biased code injection (transitive)
escalations.fix: Resolved by DEP-001 vitest upgrade (same dep chain)

escalations.title: handlebars injection & DoS (4 CVEs, max CVSS 8.2)
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install handlebars@^4.7.8 (or remove if unused)

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer never scans Specifications/
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer targets Plans/ only. 89 FRs in Specifications/ invisible to CI. Enforcer reports PASS while 76+13 requirements are untraced.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to iterate Specifications/*.md. Add CI gate: for f in Specifications/*.md; do python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file "$f"; done

p1_findings.title: dev-workflow-platform.md: 0% coverage (69 FRs, entire spec unimplemented)
p1_findings.detail: Primary platform spec defines Feature Requests, Bug Reports, Dev Cycles, Pipeline Runs. Source/ implements Self-Judging Workflow Engine — completely different domain. Zero Verifies: FR-001 comments exist anywhere.
p1_findings.recommendation: Option A: Retire as superseded with status annotation. Option B: Update to reflect actual domain. Option C: Create Plans/dev-workflow-platform/ implementation sprint.

p1_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md: 0% coverage (10 FRs)
p1_findings.detail: FR-TMP-001–010 (risk classification, Playwright E2E, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge) have zero implementation. Source/E2E/ is empty scaffold.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/ plan or add roadmap status annotation to spec.

p2_findings.title: Direct store access in route handlers (3 files)
p2_findings.detail: Route handlers import directly from ../store/workItemStore, violating CLAUDE.md 'no direct DB calls from route handlers' rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract store CRUD into workItemService.ts. Route handlers call service only.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent despite FR-WF-013 claim
p2_findings.detail: Traceability comment claims OTel compliance but zero @opentelemetry/ imports exist. Logs and Prometheus metrics are present; tracing pillar is missing.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations-node. Configure NodeSDK in tracing.ts bootstrap. Propagate W3C traceparent header.

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-metrics specifies 4 Prometheus metrics; only 3 present. dependencyCheckDuration histogram is absent.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add new Histogram({ name: 'dependency_check_duration_seconds', ... }) to metrics.ts. Instrument in computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() and detectCycle().

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies status unimplemented (spec gap)
p2_findings.detail: Spec requires persistent pending_dependencies state for blocked items. Implementation returns HTTP 400 instead, leaving item in 'approved'.
p2_findings.recommendation: Option A: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending-dependencies' to WorkItemStatus enum. Option B: Document deviation formally in spec.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion DoS via unbounded expansion (4 CVEs)
form-data CRLF injection in multipart field names (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install form-data@^4.0.6 && cd ../Frontend && npm install form-data@^4.0.6

p2_findings.title: js-yaml quadratic-complexity DoS via merge-key chains (CVSS 7.5)
postcss arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL + XSS (2 CVEs)
vite path traversal & fs.deny bypass (3 CVEs)
ws memory exhaustion DoS from tiny fragments (CVSS 7.5)

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files: WorkItemDetailPage + WorkItemListPage (761+548 lines combined)
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level file; keep tests/pages/ as canonical.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable in production source (2 instances, undocumented)
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline reason comment or fix the dependency array.

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-* spec references non-existent portal files
p3_findings.recommendation: Update FR-dependency-* to reference actual paths (Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts, WorkItem types).

p3_findings.title: express/qs moderate DoS (CVSS 5.3)
p3_findings.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm install express@^4.22.2 qs@^6.15.2

p3_findings.title: uuid buffer bounds overflow (CVSS 7.5, moderate category)
p3_findings.note: Major version jump — test UUID generation paths

p3_findings.title: react 18.3.1 → 19.2.8 (1 major version behind)
p3_findings.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm install react@^19.2.0 react-dom@^19.2.0

p4_findings.title: logger.ts is a single-line re-export stub
p4_findings.recommendation: Eliminate re-export file; update all imports to point directly to ./utils/logger.
